assets.name: Headquarters palace
assets.prompt:
Use case: stylized-concept.
Asset type: one original standalone building sprite for the future planet colony screen of Orion Reach, a Python space strategy game.
Style/medium: polished realistic sci-fi strategy-game building illustration, a finely detailed painted 3D-render appearance with clean readable silhouettes; grounded architecture, restrained materials, not cartoon, not pixel art, not a flat icon. Intended to remain recognizable at about 150–220 pixels tall. Original asset, not copied from any existing game.
Camera/composition: consistent orthographic three-quarter isometric view, camera looking down 30 degrees, showing the front and the right side, vertical edges upright, no dramatic lens or perspective. Exactly ONE complete self-contained building complex centered on a square canvas. Entire architecture and attached machinery visible with at least 8 percent empty transparent margin on every side. The front corner of its foundation sits around 88 percent down the canvas. The complex fills about 80 percent of the image width. All parts belong to the same compact connected complex.
Materials/palette: pale warm-gray ceramic and concrete, charcoal navy structural metal, muted bronze fittings; controlled cyan window and light accents. Subtle functional weathering, sharp architectural forms and realistic material shading.
Lighting: soft neutral daylight from upper left, gentle darker right faces, no sky glow. Only a tight, faint contact shadow beneath the integral foundation.
Background: genuinely transparent alpha. The building includes only its narrow built-in architectural footing, not a square terrain tile. No surrounding terrain, soil slab, horizon, sky, scenery or backdrop; no large cast shadow, opaque rectangle, solid background, or checkerboard pattern.
Constraints: no lettering, numbers, labels, logos, watermark, UI, frame, border, people or detached objects. No cropped roof, towers, cranes, antennae or foundations.
Subject: A monumental but functional space-age headquarters palace, clearly the seat of planetary government. A tall elegant central command tower rises above symmetrical terraced administrative wings and a broad formal entrance stair. A luminous cyan vertical beacon integrated into the tower and restrained bronze ceremonial trim make it an unmistakable capital landmark. Refined civic architecture with layered buttresses, rooftop communications and inset window bands. Futuristic rather than medieval: no castle walls, fantasy spires, domes resembling a historical palace, crowns or floating holograms. Its central tower is distinctly taller than ordinary colony buildings.
